question: Under what exception can purification occur here even for intentional transgressions?
premises: Purification is possible for intentional acts in this context.
Betrayal of the guru is treated as a special case.
inference: Therefore, purification may occur here even for intentional acts, except in the case of guru-treachery.
plain_english: Here, purification may be attained even for intentional acts, except for betrayal of the guru.
